name: Konohana 4 ~Yami o Harau Inori~
source:
Meguru Momoi and Miako Tachibana are back in their fourth murder-mystery adventure, along with Shinobu Sakurada. As they were taking a shinkansen (a bullet train) on their way to an excursion trip to Kyoto, they heard a scream only to stumble upon a murder scene.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/konohana-4-yami-o-harau-inori]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
桃井巡和橘美子与樱田忍一起重返第四次谋杀悬疑冒险。当他们乘坐新干线前往京都游览时，他们听到一声尖叫，却无意中发现了谋杀现场。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/konohana-4-yami-o-harau-inori]MobyGames[/url]]
